qc/runs/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/raw-evidence-index.json (scope: golden runs only; not relevant to prompt wording)
evidence: All three scored dimensions are mode="batched", aggregation="weighted_mean" (functional 43 binary, polish 5 binary, visual 5 likert) and each prompt explicitly instructs independent scoring and continuation: functional/prompt.md:13 'Once it succeeds, score EACH criterion independently, continue after failures and keep successful observations. A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row. Shared protocols reduce setup; they are not conjunctive bundles.' plus re-setup on a new job when a setup step fails, and :23 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row.'; polish/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise judge each criterion independently and continue after failures.' and :16 no double deduction; visual/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise grade every criterion independently with its five anchors and continue after failures.' Each also preserves completed observations on evaluator failure (functional:53, polish:18, visual:16 'Preserve every completed independent observation'). Grep of scored prompts, judge.toml and app_context.md for stop/first-fail/halt/abort/skip-the-rest wording found nothing; the template's 'stop and fail that criterion, then continue the rest' leg is not present and no prompt tells the judge to stop on first failure. Cascade guards in criteria: functional T protocol (prompt:39) gives a fallback seeded conversation if the new card never appears for Tomas ('graded only in hro_candidate_linked'), and criteria route shared observables to one owner ('belongs to hro_bulk_move', 'graded only in hro_pol_session_resume'). The only all-or-nothing rule is the per-dimension global browser gate (job+candidate created and seen by Observer in an independent context), which matches the template's sanctioned gate ('The global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule') and mirrors the zero-weight constraints gate, so any app it zeroes is already zeroed by the gate dimension. Gate dimensions render/constraints use aggregation=all_pass and are exempt. Counterexample attempts: (a) an app failing one early functional protocol step (e.g. J1 open fails) cannot zero later rows because the prompt mandates re-setup on a new job and forbids sibling inheritance; (b) a conforming app cannot be zeroed by one miss except via the global gate, which a conforming app passes. Limits: private check-batched-independence-wording.py was not executed (manual source review only); no configured judge run evidences that the judge obeys the wording in practice — that is a behavioural/measurement matter for other rows, not this wording row.
